map.直方图分组：组数 k 取样本量 n 的平方根或按 Sturges 公式 k =: Histogram binning: the bin count k is the square root of the sample size n, or the Sturges formula k = 1 + log₂n rounded to an integer; the bin width h = (max − min) ÷ k; each bin frequency = the number of values falling in the left-closed right-open interval; frequency density = frequency ÷ (sample size × bin width), with rectangle area representing the frequency distribution of each bin.
map.成绩分段：把试卷分数分组，看各分数段人数分布，辅助难度评估。: Score bands: group exam scores to see how many students fall in each band.
map.时长分布：对任务耗时分组，识别多数集中在哪一区间，便于排期预估。: Duration distribution: bin task durations to see where most values cluster for scheduling.
map.质量抽检：对尺寸测量值分组，观察是否围绕目标值集中。: Quality sampling: bin dimension measurements to see whether they cluster around the target.
map.输入 50 条作答秒数，设组距 30 秒，工具输出「0–30:12 / 30–6: Enter 50 response times in seconds and set the bin width to 30 seconds; the tool outputs a frequency bar chart such as "0-30: 12 / 30-60: 23 / 60-90: 15", showing that most fall in the 30-60 second band.
map.组距怎么定？: How should the bin width be set?
map.边界值算哪组？: Which bin do boundary values fall into?
map.样本过小时分布参考性弱，建议结合其他统计一起看，仅作探索性参考。: With very small samples the distribution is only weakly informative; use it as an exploratory reference alongside other statistics.
map.直方图（分组/频数）生成。数据分析工具，帮助快速处理与可视化数据。: Histogram (bins and frequency) generator. Data analysis tools that help you process and visualize data quickly.
map.组数 k 由输入指定（留空则按 Sturges 公式 k = ⌈1 + log₂: Bin count k is user-specified (blank uses Sturges: k = ⌈1 + log₂n⌉); bin width h = (max − min) ÷ k; each bin count = values in the left-closed right-open interval [lower, upper) (last bin closed); frequency = count ÷ n; frequency density = count ÷ (n × h).
map.直接粘贴原始数据即可得到分组频数表；同一组数据与组数重复计算结果完全一致。: Paste raw values to get a grouped frequency table; the same data and bin count always give identical results.
map.组数怎么定？: How many bins should I use?
map.可手填 1–20 的组数，留空则按 Sturges 公式 k = ⌈1 + lo: Enter 1–20 bins, or leave blank for Sturges k = ⌈1 + log₂n⌉; too few bins hide structure, too many leave each bin under-sampled.
map.区间规则：左闭右开，最后一组闭合；频率密度 = 频数 ÷（n × 组距），矩形面: Bin rule: left-closed and right-open, with the last bin closed; frequency density = count ÷ (n × bin width); the bar areas sum to 1.
map.输入 50 条作答秒数、设 5 组，工具按极差均分组距，输出各组频数与频率，可看: Enter 50 answer times and set 5 bins; the tool divides the range evenly into bins and outputs counts and frequencies, showing where most answers cluster.
map.组数留空时按 Sturges 公式 ceil(1+log2 n) 计算；也可手动: If the bin count is left empty, it is computed with Sturges' formula ceil(1+log2 n); you can also set it manually — too few bins hide structure, too many leave too few samples per bin.
map.区间采用左闭右开 [a, b)，最后一组闭合为 [a, b]；组界值归入右侧组。: Bins use left-closed, right-open intervals [a, b), with the last bin closed [a, b]; boundary values go into the bin on the right.
